tasks.ExpandPolynomialsAndCompareCoefficients: Multiply the polynomials (3t^2 + 5t + a) and (4t^2 + bt - 2), then compare coefficients with the given polynomial 12t^4 + 26t^3 - 8t^2 - 16t + 6.
tasks.SolveSystemOfEquations: Solve the system of equations derived from comparing coefficients to find values of a and b.
